messages:
deploy-bot: Preflight: release 20260405-12 blocked for service=runtime-agent. Env-parity check failed: PROD missing internal cert at path certs/internal/runtime-agent.pem

deploy-bot: details:
```
> check: file-presence
> env: prod
> path: certs/internal/runtime-agent.pem
> result: NOT_FOUND
> staging: present
```

Eve: Not good. I merged a config that updated TLS config for staging only to test mTLS. Somehow the config bump made it into the release bundle but the cert sync never ran for prod.

Rohan: Can we push the cert now? Is the signing KMS alias the same in prod? If not, we need infra involvement.

Maya: Prod uses a different signing workflow and requires an ops-approved paramstore entry. Hotpatching straight to prod without the signing alias will break verification. This is outside the current change window.

Diego: Given that, safest path is to pin the image back and pause. We can't risk serving with mismatched TLS certs. Also let's add a short entry in the release notes about the env parity issue so customers know there was no code regression.

Eve: I'll create a rollback PR and pin to redwood/runtime-agent:2026-04-01-stable. Command: `./scripts/release pin-image --service runtime-agent --tag 2026-04-01-stable`

deploy-bot: Action: release 20260405-12 paused by Eve. To proceed after manual updates run `/release unpause 20260405-12` or requeue with updated artifact.

Rohan: I'll open INF-7480 for infra to run the cert sync and confirm signing alias is available for prod. Also adding a deploycheck to assert cert file presence before unpause.

Maya: Thanks. I'll add a short runbook item in the infra ticket for manual verification steps post-sync: verify checksum, confirm mTLS handshake against canary, then merge config that references the prod cert path.

Diego: PR for rollback posted: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/releases/rollback/217. Includes changelog note: "Release paused: discovered missing prod internal cert; rolled back to previous stable image; infra will sync cert and we will reschedule."

deploy-bot: Rollback started by Eve at 2026-04-05T11:08:40Z. Canary checks passing. Prod revert complete at 2026-04-05T11:12:15Z. Release remains paused pending INF-7480 and cert-sync verification.

Eve: I'll also add a brief postmortem item in the release notes draft: root cause = staging-only config merged without prod cert sync; fix = enforce deploycheck, add cert-sync gate, and include explicit infra signoff for TLS changes.

Rohan: INF-7480 created and assigned. I'll notify infra oncall in #eng-infra and schedule a 10-min sync in next change window to perform the sync.

Maya: Once infra confirms, we'll re-run the preflight in a dev cluster and then unpause. Keeping this paused until the cert is present in prod avoids emergency writes during the release window.

Diego: Sounds good. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
